# Owen Ford

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
- **Role:** newspaper man, writer, and author  <sub>[v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c24 P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Owen Ford is a handsome, tall, and broad-shouldered man with thick brown hair and finely cut features. He has large, brilliant dark-gray eyes and nice, well-shaped teeth. Unsmiling, his face carries a sad and absent expression, but it lights up with charm, mirth, and humor when he smiles.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c25 P13](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0013)_

## Personality

Owen is an imaginative, passionate, and eager writer who throws himself heart and soul into his work. He possesses a strong sense of humor, passion, and artistic expression. Friendly and charming, he delights in good fellowship, merry outings, and inspiring beauty.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c25 P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 c25 P13](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0013), [v4 c25 P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014)_

## Traits

- eager  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c25 P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009)</sub>
- passionate  <sub>[v4 c25 P13](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- short story writing and literary composition  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006), [v4 c25 P11](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- to write a great Canadian novel based on a strong central idea  <sub>[v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
- to write a famous book by turning Captain Jim's life-book into a published novel  <sub>[v4 c25 P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)</sub>

## History

Owen Ford arrived at Four Winds for a vacation, intending to gain inspiration for a novel. Upon arriving, he boarded at Leslie Moore's house and was immediately struck by her extraordinary beauty. Anne Shirley introduced him to Captain Jim, whose life-book and stories captivated Owen. Realizing the potential of Captain Jim's experiences and the tale of lost Margaret, Owen began collaborating with Captain Jim, using a lighthouse room as his workshop. Throughout the summer, he threw himself feverishly into writing while joining Anne, Gilbert, Leslie, and Captain Jim on outings. Over the course of the summer, he fell deeply in love with Leslie, whose personality inspired the heroine of his manuscript. After completing his book, he declared his love to Leslie in the little house's garden, receiving her love in return.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000), [v4 c23 P16](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0016), [v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c23 P26](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0026), [v4 c23 P34](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0034), [v4 c24 P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027), [v4 c24 P34](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0034), [v4 c24 P39](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0039), [v4 c25 P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006), [v4 c25 P8](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0008), [v4 c25 P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 c25 P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 c25 P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- grandson of John Selwyn, the schoolmaster who built the old house at Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c23 P12](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0012), [v4 c25 P7](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0007)</sub>
- son of a woman born and raised at Four Winds who married and moved away  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)</sub>
- worked as a newspaper man and wrote short stories for magazines  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

## Quotes

> You cannot realize how delighted I am to be here, Mrs. Blythe. I have an odd feeling of coming home.  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011)</sub>

> And so this is Four Winds. I wasn’t prepared to find it quite so beautiful, in spite of all mother’s praises. What colors—what scenery—what charm!  <sub>[v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018)</sub>

> We’ll collaborate. You will give the soul and I the body. Oh, we’ll write a famous book between us, Captain Jim. And we’ll get right to work.  <sub>[v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)</sub>

> Yes—love triumphant and perfect. Leslie, you know—you understand. I have loved you from the first. And I KNOW you love me—I don’t need to ask you. But I want to hear you say it—my darling—my darling!  <sub>[v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009)</sub>


## Relationships

### Leslie Moore

- Romantic with — Owen falls deeply in love with Leslie during his stay at Four Winds and proposes to her.  <sub>[v4 c23 P26](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0026), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)</sub>

### Captain Jim

- Comrade of — Collaborates with Captain Jim to adapt his life-book into a novel.  <sub>[v4 c25 P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006), [v4 c25 P8](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0008)</sub>

### John Selwyn

- Child of — John Selwyn is Owen Ford's grandfather.  <sub>[v4 c23 P11](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0011), [v4 c25 P7](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0007)</sub>
